title: Demo Video Plan
description: Marketing or recording brief for the Planevo demo-video director.

intent.description: Output goal — drives capture and compose pipeline selection.

audience.description: Who the video is for (e.g. founders, end users, investors).

capture.description: Capture pipeline override; usually derived from intent.

compose.description: Post-capture composition override; usually derived from intent.

music.description: Whether to include background music in the final output.

voiceover.description: Whether to generate or include a voiceover track.

captions.description: Caption cues or SRT-style lines to burn in or export.

url.description: App base URL for capture (default http://localhost:3000).

brief.description: Original natural-language brief; used for intent hints only.
